title: Verified Knowledge to Case Reply
description: Use an observed live help revision to prepare a grounded, unsent reply for an exact open support case.
setup_prompt: Use Verified Knowledge to Case Reply as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Crews, source permissions, exact subject, owner and action policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, typed handoffs, a real manual first case and separate approval for consequential actions. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection enables no write or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: One product, help article and exact open case, locale, recipient, support owner and contact policy.
Read the live help revision and publication receipt, current case thread and account state, approved product facts and suppression history.
An approved article draft is not live knowledge. Recheck the published revision, case applicability and permission before a separate reply approval.
Accountable source, decision and action owners
Authorized connections or equivalent current exports
Manual-only or reviewed event and schedule policy
